task: Create a Word (.docx) document named car_driver_summary.docx. In this document, write a summary listing all unique drivers from the car inventory PDF, along with their assigned car color. Include a brief introductory paragraph stating: 'This document summarizes the drivers and their assigned car colors as recorded in the May 2020 car inventory.' Under the introduction, list each driver and their car color in the format 'Driver: [Name], Color: [Color]'. Save the file as car_driver_summary.docx.
query_sentence: Create a Word summary document for all drivers from the car inventory and their assigned car colors.

ground_truth_memory.fact: Create a Word document called car_driver_summary.docx.
Write an introductory paragraph: 'This document summarizes the drivers and their assigned car colors as recorded in the May 2020 car inventory.'
